chunks: With this chain, from 'Amr ibn Jubayr al-'Arzami, from his father, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

Whoever recites Surah Luqman every night, Allah appoints for him angels that protect him from Iblees and his army until morning. If he recites it during the day, they continue to protect him from Iblees and his army until evening.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward and spiritual benefit of reciting Surah Luqman daily?
ai.summary: In Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-Amal*, this narration underscores the practical efficacy of Surah Luqman as a spiritual shield against the whispers of Iblees, reflecting the Shia emphasis on daily dhikr for divine preservation. The distinction between night and day recitation illustrates the continuous nature of divine guardianship, ensuring the believer remains protected from evil forces throughout the full cycle of their daily life.
